findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_packages, get_package_details, search_all_tours, list_destinations, get_city, get_affiliate_services, get_contact_info, get_careers, get_reviews, request_to_book · Private data: get_package_details, get_contact_info, get_terms, request_to_book, request_custom_itinerary · Public sink: get_package_details, get_city, get_contact_info, get_careers, get_terms, request_to_book, request_custom_itinerary, send_whatsapp_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_packages, get_package_details, search_all_tours, list_destinations, get_city, get_affiliate_services, get_contact_info, get_careers, get_reviews, request_to_book · Private data: get_package_details, get_contact_info, get_terms, request_to_book, request_custom_itinerary · Public sink: get_package_details, get_city, get_contact_info, get_careers, get_terms, request_to_book, request_custom_itinerary, send_whatsapp_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
